subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw add a read-only, agent-scoped workspace file browser for mobile apps now, separate from the broader workspace CRUD API?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but arbitrary workspace reads through Gateway and mobile clients change a security boundary and the issue is protected by the maintainer label.

options.title: Approve Narrow Read-Only Slice
options.body: Land bounded `agents.workspace` list/read RPCs plus iOS/Android browse, preview, and share UI after owner security review.

options.title: Defer To Full Workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers resolve the broader workspace-management direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/62417.

options.title: Keep Existing Boundaries
options.body: Leave mobile apps without arbitrary workspace browsing and preserve the current bootstrap-file and session-touched-file API boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Read-Only Slice
recommendation.body: Land bounded `agents.workspace` list/read RPCs plus iOS/Android browse, preview, and share UI after owner security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature request and authored the stacked gateway/mobile implementation candidates.
